newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average falls more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average falls more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average fell more than 50 points Friday as stocks came under pressure from weakness in high techs, incuding industry giants International Business Machines Corp. and Intel Corp.
Just after 10:25 a.m. EDT, the Dow was down 54.98 points at 6,737.27, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
